title: Admins choose plugin access per group
summary: Admins can choose which plugins staff, volunteers and students may use in each organisation module. Admins always keep full access.
changes: Add a Group access tab under Admin, Access, with one switch per plugin for staff, volunteers and students in each module.
Turning a plugin off for a group hides it from that group's menu and blocks its pages.
Switches only take access away from a group's usual access; they never add to it, and Admins are never affected.
Record every change in the audit log.
version_rationale: Patch: adds an Admin setting that starts with today's access for every group, with a new table and no data change.
validation: New feature test for the default access, turning a plugin off for students, Admin access, the audit log and non-Admin refusal.
Authorization, navigation, Admin access and Recruitment access tests.
known_limitations: Switches apply per group, not per person. Switching a plugin off for staff also removes it from staff who hold a job role for it.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release package. The new table can stay; earlier releases ignore it.
provenance: Milestone v0.46.3 Beta, issue #460 under epic #458, pull request #591.
